_comment: Host-OS details that Chrome's release feed does not carry. These are the
ONLY hand-maintained values in this repo; everything else is derived from
upstream Chrome releases or ported from Chromium source. They feed the
high-entropy client hints, except ios_version, which also appears in the
iOS user agent because Chrome on iOS is not UA-reduced.
Bump os_versions_verified whenever you review these. The generator warns
once they are more than 180 days old, so drift shows up instead of quietly
_windows_note: On Windows, Sec-CH-UA-Platform-Version is NOT the Windows version. Chrome
Windows 11 24H2+      -> higher; Chromium currently caps its fallback at 19
Anything >= 13.0.0 means Windows 11. Use 10.0.0 to present as Windows 10.
